description: This source file defines an Android instrumentation test class 'StartupMacrobenchmark' that performs benchmark tests measuring app startup time and UI responsiveness using the androidx.benchmark macrobenchmark framework.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: An Android JUnit test class that runs performance benchmarks on app startup and UI responsiveness.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Performs a cold startup benchmark by launching the app after returning to the home screen.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Performs a startup and scroll action benchmark measuring frame timing metrics during UI interactions.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Executes a benchmark block and skips the test if known device issues are detected.
